_comment: Template showing the pack schema. Venue data below is fictional placeholder content — replace with real curated venues before use. See docs/product-brief.md on why curation is the moat.
title: A slow Saturday in <neighbourhood>
standfirst: One or two lines of framing. What kind of day is this, and who is it for?

venues.name: <venue name>
venues.note: One line in your own voice. Say something Google could not — why this one, what to order, when to go, what it's like in the rain. If it reads like a review summary, the pack isn't curated.

_schema_notes.venues: 8-12 is the sweet spot. Fewer and reshuffle produces the same plan twice; more and curation stops being curation.
_schema_notes.placeId: Null until batch-resolved from the name. Once resolved, placeId is the storable key — do not persist other Google Places fields; hydrate them on read. Verify current Google Maps Platform terms.
_schema_notes.lat_lng: For a small demo pack, right-click the venue in Google Maps and copy coordinates. Faster and more reliable than a resolver script.
_schema_notes.category: Short display label — Coffee, Dinner, Drinks, Browsing, Culture, Outdoors.
_schema_notes.walking: All venues in a pack should be within sensible walking distance of each other, or the routing produces a bad day out.
